name: tios-app
description: TIOS 科技投资操作系统 —— 规则驱动的交易决策闭环小程序

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.web: npm run web:snapshot && npm run dev:open --workspace frontend
scripts.web:snapshot: cd backend && WEB=1 HTML=1 npx tsx src/services/cockpit/run.ts
scripts.web:build: npm run web:snapshot && npm run build:offline --workspace frontend
scripts.web:lan: npm run web:snapshot && node scripts/lan-url.mjs && npm run dev:lan --workspace frontend
scripts.web:deploy: npm run web:build && npm run web:preflight
